patthana18.3:1.1: hetuṃ hetuñceva sahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetuceva na ahetukoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:2.1: nahetuṃ sahetukañceva nacahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na ahetukoceva na nahetuca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. hetuduka hetuhetusampayuttaduke nahetuduka nahetuhetusampayuttadukaṃ
patthana18.3:3.1: hetuṃ hetuñceva hetusampayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetuceva na hetuvippayuttoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:4.1: nahetuṃ hetusampayuttañceva nacahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na nahetu na hetuvippayuttoceva na nahetuca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. hetuduka nahetusahetukaduke nahetuduka nahetunasahetukadukaṃ
patthana18.3:5.1: nahetuṃ nahetuṃ sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu nahetu na sahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana18.3:6.1: nahetuṃ nahetuṃ ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetu na hetu na ahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ. hetuduka sappaccayaduke nahetuduka nasappaccayadukaṃ
